HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 68-year-old male admitted for cellulitis of the left lower leg. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.79, creatinine 0.9-1.14, hemoglobin 14.2, platelets 202-206, sodium 139, wbc 8-8.3; vitals dbp 70-75, heart_rate 75-80, map 89-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 126-129, spo2 96-97, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Cefazolin 2 g IV
Assessment and plan: Cellulitis of the left lower leg. Acute kidney injury.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient seen and examined at bedside. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1.35-1.63, hemoglobin 14.1-14.2, platelets 201, sodium 139, wbc 8.2-8.6; vitals dbp 71-74, heart_rate 76-81, map 90-93, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 128-132, spo2 96-97, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Cefazolin 2 g IV; Lactated Ringer's 1 L IV bolus
Assessment and plan: Cellulitis of the left lower leg. Acute kidney injury. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 68-year-old male, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Cellulitis of the left lower leg. Acute kidney injury. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
